core_results.atomic_execution_truth: passed for same-database mutations inside one pinned Aksara transaction
core_results.fenceable_ownership: passed when ownership is locked and checked inside the mutation transaction
core_results.multiprocess: exclusive claim, hard worker death, database-time reclaim, and stale credential attack passed
core_results.negative_controls: both split-commit directions, different connection, finalization-only check, removed fence, missing attempt heartbeat, and nonincrementing fence defects detected
core_results.pool_and_tenant_reuse: passed with forced RLS and a restricted role

next_gate: eligible for a separately reviewed internal migration and repository milestone; this prototype does not authorize later API or integration milestones
required_constraints: same Aksara Database instance and same PostgreSQL database
one active pinned connection and outer transaction
current operation, attempt, worker, fence, running state, and lease validated under that lock
all application writes use the pinned session
attempt success, operation success, transition, and outbox written before the same commit
no direct pool acquisition, independent commit, or concurrent use of the pinned connection
no external effect included in the PostgreSQL atomic guarantee
ambiguous commit outcomes are re-read from PostgreSQL before retry
